column8: Review & Preview 6-87. For the end-of-year party, Mt. Rose Middle School ordered 112 pizzas. There were eight fewer veggie pizzas than there were pepperoni pizzas. Is one strategy more efficient than the other? b. Solve 7 = 3x − 5. Show your steps. Methods & Meanings DEFINING A VARIABLE When you write an equation, it is important to define the variable precisely. You need to be clear about what you are talking about so that someone else looking at your work would understand what the variable represents. This is an important habit to develop because it is an important step in solving many different math problems. For example, suppose you have the following problem: At the neighborhood grocery store, grapes cost $3 a pound. If Belinda spent $5.40 on grapes, how many pounds of grapes did she buy? One equation you could write is 3x = 5.4 if you know what x stands for. The variable x should be clearly defined, such as x = pounds of grapes, rather than just x = grapes. You could also write g = pounds of grapes, since any letter may be used as a variable.
